inventory.q: Are the materials we ordered in stock? Are they available at other sites' warehouses?
inventory.a: Prizma's modular structure makes warehouse and project-level stock control fast and accurate — you can check availability across every site.

open.q: What's the status of open procurement, payment, or material requests? How long have they been pending?
open.a: The Process module gives you full, transparent visibility into where each request sits, who hasn't approved yet, and how long it's been pending. Add comments and reminders inline.

suppliers.q: Which suppliers did we get quotes from? What price did each one offer?
suppliers.a: Prizma stores detailed supplier info and lets you attach multiple alternative quotes per request — full transparency for procurement teams.

about.title: 21 years building ERP for construction
about.subtitle: Prizma is a powerful BPM, ERP, reporting and accounting platform — purpose-built for the construction industry and refined over two decades of real projects.
about.yearsBody: From the first procurement request to the final settlement, Prizma is shaped by how construction teams actually work.
about.storyBody1: Prizma began on construction sites, not in a boardroom. After 21 years working alongside contractors, we built a single platform that connects budgets, procurement, warehouses, finance and HR.
about.storyBody2: Today more than 5,000 users run their daily operations on Prizma — planning projects, routing approvals and tracking spend across every site in real time.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Make construction management effortless
mission.body: Give construction companies an innovative, easy-to-use ERP that boosts efficiency, unifies business processes and delivers projects on budget and on time.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: The ERP standard for construction
vision.body: To become the leading ERP for the construction sector worldwide — combining technological innovation with data analytics to build sustainable, competitive businesses.

services.title: Prizma in construction: every department, unified for peak efficiency
services.subtitle: One ERP that connects company and project management — control costs, finish tasks faster and raise productivity across the board.

planning.title: Project planning & progress tracking
planning.body: Compare planned vs. actual costs in real time, spot budget deviations and delays early, and make data-driven decisions.

inventory.title: Inventory & warehouse management
inventory.body: Centralize procurement and stock from requisition to delivery, reserve materials and avoid unnecessary purchases.

contracts.title: Contracts & work settlements
contracts.body: Automate contractor agreements and completed-work calculations, including penalties and deductions based on site reports.

finance.title: Financial processes & accounting
finance.body: Manage banking, cash, credits and checks with bank integration for secure, fast payments and clear financial reporting.

personnel.title: Personnel management & payroll
personnel.body: Consolidate employee data, collect field work hours, manage leave and generate monthly payroll with document tracking.

mrp.title: Material requirements planning
mrp.body: Plan material needs in advance with real-time inventory monitoring to prevent shortages and surpluses.

accounting.title: Cumulative income & expense accounting
accounting.body: Advanced reporting tracks revenue and expense in real time, analyzed by project and period for reliable budgeting.

customers.title: Customer account management
customers.body: Track income and expense per project or customer to assess profitability with precision.

dashboards.title: Dashboards & data visualization
dashboards.body: Customizable panels show financial and operational metrics as real-time graphs for faster decisions.
